node.title: Re^2: Very Odd Issue When Using pp to Create an .exe File Including Date::Calc
node.author: perldigious
node.doctext:
Thanks for the suggestion [karlgoethebier], though I do have a way to make [http://search.cpan.org/~stbey/Date-Calc-6.4/lib/Date/Calc.pod|Date::Calc] work as it should anyway. I was just really confused by how something as seemingly inconsequential as listing all the use statements on one line vs. separate lines could make the .exe either fail or work respectively with no other difference... very odd to me, since it didn't seem like it should ever matter.

Just another Perl hooker - But the purist monks keep telling me I should do it for love, not money.
